scope: Final animation pass for exactly four redrawn units. Forty genuinely authored front/back poses; no gameplay, balance, backend or static portrait changes. Existing renderer paths are reused.
preparation: User-approved technical matte removal and atlas packing using prepare-unit-pose-sheet.mjs looseGrid mode, preserving whole-figure proportions and one shared source scale across all ten poses. Real authored walk replacements are individually keyed, cropped through empty gutters and proportionally scaled to the corresponding existing walk A height; headless rear walks use 157px (rear idle body height) because the raised sword was removed. All figures anchored at y=236. No mirrored, cloned, warped or procedurally painted character anatomy.
paletteSpecificCleanup: No authored purple in the approved designs. Residual min(R,B)-G>20: alpha*=clamp((60-dominance)/40,0,1); zero transparent pixels, otherwise cap R/B at G+8. Synthetic palette preservation, pure-key removal, soft-alpha and idempotence assertions. Only chroma-spill pixels affected.
integration: Grounding opts in these last four from measured static alpha bounds. Soul Hunter uses the existing grounded ranged pose path. Grave Raider and Headless Knight retain melee lunges. War Chaplain remains range-2 offensive armor support with short scepter strike, not a heal/cast. Its gameplay ability is unchanged.

Keep head and body equally broad in all poses. In rear row dark braids and leather back visible, bone shoulder same anatomical side. Defeat entire heavy body on its side, axe touching gauntlet.
